title: Emergent Gravity, Gauge Curvature, and Spacetime Geometry from E6 Hypercomplex Spinor Structure
content: We develop a non-associative hypercomplex spinor framework in which spacetime geometry, gauge interactions, and gravitational dynamics emerge from a unified E₆-related algebraic structure. The theory is constructed from a sixteen-dimensional steering–spinor geometry based on quaternionic, octonionic, and sedenionic sectors generated through the Cayley–Dickson hierarchy. Electromagnetic, weak, and strong interactions arise naturally from distinct spinor sectors and their tensor couplings, while spacetime curvature emerges from generalized steering operators and associator-induced geometric corrections. The resulting commutator and associator structures generate Yang–Mills-like gauge curvature and Einstein-like gravitational dynamics within a common algebraic framework. In the weak-field limit, the theory reproduces Newtonian gravity and admits Schwarzschild-like solutions. The framework further provides geometric interpretations of fermion generations and mass hierarchy, suggesting a possible pathway toward quantum gravity and unified fundamental interactions grounded in hypercomplex spinor geometry.
